findings.message: The first raw data block that is read to its end holds SBR data, which decides the stream as HE-AAC as FFmpeg 6.1.1 does, but 3 of 10 raw data blocks hold SBR data; the first block that disagrees is raw data block 4.

ADTS cannot signal SBR or PS explicitly, but 3 of 10 raw data blocks hold SBR data: the stream is HE-AAC, signaled only implicitly, with an output rate of 44100 Hz. Decoders without SBR play the AAC LC core at 22050 Hz.
